problem_evidence.runtime: V8 Agent only stops three consecutive page_changed=false actions excluding WAIT; observed changed=true cycles can continue. Existing legacy fingerprint omits top-level page_key and guards. Model.choose has no bounded observation-revisit metadata.
problem_evidence.existing_progress_module: scripts/jev_owned_form_progress.py is an offline authored-route admission/reference compiler, not this runtime loop mechanism.

contract.exact: Hashes all accepted page fields including document page_key, guards, complete ordered actions/rects and profile diagnostics; excludes only screenshot and supplied legacy fingerprint. Same URL alone is insufficient.
contract.optional_projection: Explicit opt-in. Hashes URL/title/all existing observed text/profile id/viewport/full scroll/editable values plus ordered semantic action descriptors. Removes only recognized native e{position} bindings, their node/rect and known proxy/hover bindings, plus three fixed native control IDs. Does not remove semantic DOM id/name/URL/value strings. Omits document time, geometry and guard payloads; equality is not complete state or action identity.
contract.bounded: At most 32 retained digest tuples, no raw page/guard/candidate text retained; sequence integers 0..2^53-1; repeated identical sequence is idempotent, backwards or contradictory sequence refuses. Output <=4096 bytes.
contract.notes: Factual retained observation-sequence matches only. Does not assert no effect/no progress/goal state; does not choose, block, reorder or trim any action, candidate, history, goal or head. Fresh original guards are never changed or reused.
contract.original_text_scope: Original snapshot text is already bounded by the existing native observer; this source performs no additional truncation. All already-observed editable state is hashed, including value/checked/select/disabled/readOnly; raw values are not output.

meaningful_cases: document reload/node/geometry/guard identity versus explicitly weaker projection
unknown semantic DOM id/name and literal e42-like values retained
all observed editable fields and full existing text retained
malformed or contradictory JSON/sequence refuses atomically

limitations: All three original task outcomes remain decision-budget failures. Replay proves detection on saved states, not task-quality improvement.
The curl trace is not covered because its observed scroll state changes; no ineffective-scroll claim is made.
No Model.choose integration, new request/schema/token budget/native decode qualification, browser rerun, GPU/framework/model/processor run, resource-gate change or cache operation occurred.

A future separately named experimental profile may place this small metadata inside existing observation/state input; it must preserve strict outer schema, instructions, candidates/order, labels/heads/decoder/model math and undergo fresh capacity plus real browser evaluation. Old V8/Q95 capacity evidence does not cover the new prompt.

research_before_code.decision: New tiny stdlib core rather than an action-override framework or full V8 copy. Use bounded informational context principle only; no upstream source/normalization copied and no new dependency.

references.detail: ActionLoopDetector; MIT, main content read 2026-10-20, not immutable commit-pinned. Bounded context principle; upstream weak URL/text/action matching is not adopted as exact guard identity.
